editorial.blurb: A spacious Chinatown stalwart known for dim sum, where cart service and family-style dining shine in a comfortable, well-maintained setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive after 10am when stir-fried dishes start cooking; order dim sum early and ask your server (like Julie) to guide you through the menu—the carts move fast and the dumplings are where this place excels.
signatureDishes: Dim sum (shrimp dumplings, pork dumplings, steamed bean curd roll, chive and shrimp wraps)
